summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）归档增强插件：自动定期归档、文件夹归档整理、LLM 摘要沉淀经验库、会话收藏与便签、会话删除与优雅关机。Archive enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness: auto-archive, folder organization, LLM knowledge library, bookmarks & notes, session delete.
